method: Flat water surfaces per reach. Extent: hydro-flattened water surfaces of the Lantmäteriet 1 m DTM (steps at dams and falls), cut from the OSM water polygons. Level: median LiDAR class 9 return (flight 2020) where at least 25 cells exist, otherwise the flattened DTM level; the sea and the tidal river use the SMHI 2021-2025 mean sea level. Generated by scripts/prepare-water-reaches.py and scripts/prepare-water-reaches.mjs. Levels are a snapshot (regulated reaches vary).

sources.dtm: Lantmäteriet Markhöjdmodell Nedladdning 1 m (EPSG:5845, RH2000), hydro-flattened over water
sources.lidar: Lantmäteriet Laserdata Nedladdning, class 9 (water) mean per 2 m cell, flight 2020
sources.sea: SMHI ocobs Juten-Djurökvarn (35101), mean 2021-2025 = +0.14 m RH2000
